summary: Greatwick blocker GW-1 is closed: re-measured live sweep plus eye review of every Wick sheet, and no Wick or ward reads as a face. All five done-criteria hold when re-measured: B5 value_probe passes on 3 maps x 2 tiers (VFX flash 2.02-2.77x, so the CW1 flash handoff did not reproduce), fog is 0.537-0.542, wallmask is RIFT 0/48 and FRAY 0/24, the landmark gate passes, the minors are in, and the Wick hoods top out at L* 62.5 against the fighters' 81.1. The wave still fails on 2 majors. (1) env:E1: the landmarks clear the lane, but they reach only about 0.4x the Art 2.0 structures' high-pass, which is short of the wave goal of 'the same tier'. (2) critic:monsters: the Stray Numeral reads as a pillar in camp, the Stilltusk Young is still a near-smooth blob, and there is no 'neutral units' score row. typecheck and content:check are clean. perf_1080 was not re-run by me.

items.evidence: As done:5.

The criterion gate passes (done:2), but the wave goal is 'finished to the same tier as the Art 2.0 structures'. In the same metric the landmarks reach hp 1.6-1.9 against the structures' 3.65-4.46 (fw_CW4_v1_b5 __refs), about 0.4x. By eye (value_rift_high_fw_CW4_v1_lmk_numeral_xi.png), the XI head bar and stroke faces are clean, soft-mottled grey slabs with crisp box edges, and the 'earth bank' is three smooth dark boulders. The fair stands (value_fray_high_fw_CW4_v1_lmk_fair_stand_nw.png) read as clean concrete blocks. Better than before (old XI stroke hp 0.92 in my metric), but not yet at the structures' finish or at par 7.5 for this major. The engineers also self-report partly.
items.fixHint: Raise face hp toward >= 0.75x the structures (about 2.8 in value_probe --landmarks): chip and bevel-break the stroke and head-bar edges (no perfect box arrises), paint darker cavity and grime bands at each course joint and the base, put stronger lichen and stain value steps on the head bar, and replace the three-boulder bank with a broken earth-and-rubble skirt that has painted value. For the fair stands, add worn edges, a darker cavity under each bench and a grime ramp at the foot. Re-measure with value_probe --landmarks.
